subject: Reserved capacity tenor / GPU price exposure - Pioneer Labs PO & discount ask
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@pioneer.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: priya.menon@pioneer.ai
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved capacity request + discount ask (Pioneer)

Irene / Marcus —

Thanks for the demo last week. Pioneer is ready to move forward with reserved capacity for our inference workloads. High level ask: a 36‑month reserved commitment targeting 1.5M GPU‑hours/year (mix attached) with annual ramp windows. Given the size, we are requesting a blended discount off list with a mechanism to protect both sides if GPU spot/wholesale prices move >15% in a quarter.

Key asks from our procurement team:
- Clear pricing cadence and indexation clause (if market GPU cost changes, adjust unit price within agreed bands)
- A pre‑agreed discount ladder tied to committed volume tiers
- Option for a 10% burst pool above the committed capacity for the first 12 months
- Draft PO (we attached a template) and contract term — we prefer a 36‑month tenor with quarterly forecasting windows

Attached: pioneer_sku_mapping.xlsx (breakdown by GPU class and expected monthly consumption).

Can your team outline how you would structure the discount approval and any standard market indexation language Redwood uses? Also flag anything that needs executive approval.

— Amit
Head of Infrastructure, Pioneer Labs
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@pioneer.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity request + discount ask (Pioneer)

Amit — thanks, and thanks for the SKU mapping. We reviewed the numbers and sketched a proposal so we can move procurement <> finance <> legal quickly. Summary below (high level; we'll share a redline once pricing is approved):

1) Committed footprint and bursts
- Baseline: 1.5M GPU‑hours/year, delivered as a reserved pool across Aurora‑A100 and Aurora‑H100 equivalents (monthly allocation in attached PO draft).
- Burst: 10% burst pool for first 12 months; billed at a higher incremental rate (we propose 1.6x committed unit price) unless you want to convert bursts into committed capacity during the term.

2) Discount ladder (blended effective discount off list price) — internal approval needed
- Tier A (>=100% of baseline): 28% off list
- Tier B (75–99%): 22% off list
- Tier C (50–74%): 15% off list
(These are placeholders — final approval required from Finance for anything >25% blended)

3) GPU price‑index clause (protects both sides)
- Trigger: if Redwood wholesale GPU procurement cost changes more than ±12% quarter over quarter, unit price will be adjusted within a capped corridor of ±10% after review and notification.
- Escalation: adjustments above ±10% require Finance & Legal signoff and an executive escalation window (5 business days).

4) Approval path + ask to you
- We need internal Finance signoff for any blended discount >25% and Legal review on the indexation wording.
- Can you confirm Pioneer is ok with the 12% trigger and 10% capped adjustment? If not, highlight your target bands and we can trade against tenor/PO cadence.

Attached: po_draft_v2.pdf (draft PO with monthly allocation) and noted the SKU mapping you provided.

If you agree in principle, I will loop in Kimberly (pricing) and Marcus (ops) to finalize the numbers and route for approval.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Deals — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Jun 2028 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity request + discount ask (Pioneer)

Irene / Marcus —

On Thu, Jun 13, 2028 at 12:05 PM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 2) Discount ladder (blended effective discount off list price) — internal approval needed
> - Tier A (>=100% of baseline): 28% off list
> - Tier B (75–99%): 22% off list
> - Tier C (50–74%): 15% off list
> (These are placeholders — final approval required from Finance for anything >25% blended)

We ran the quick model. Finance is comfortable with up to 25% blended discount for a 36‑month term if Pioneer commits to quarterly forecasting windows and a PO with a rolling 6‑month visibility requirement. Anything above 25% requires Director approval + a margin protection clause (monthly margin floor) to avoid negative unit economics in a rapid GPU price spike.

Two things for the legal team to bake into the contract:
- A defined GPU procurement index (we propose a transparent-fair benchmark feed we already use internally) and the notification cadence (30 days before any applied price change).
- An emergency relief clause if supply-side GPU costs increase >30% in any single quarter (gives both parties a path to renegotiate quantities/tenor).

Next step: Marcus / Irene, if you want to pursue a 25% cap, I can prepare the formal pricing memo and route for Director signoff today.

— Kim
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@pioneer.ai>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@pioneer.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Reserved capacity request + discount ask (Pioneer)

Amit / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the mapping. Short summary and next steps so procurement can close:

- Redwood can move forward on a 36‑month reserved tenor targeting 1.5M GPU‑hours/year.
- Pricing: we can offer a blended discount up to 25% off list pending Director signoff (Kimberly will route the memo today). Anything above 25% needs Exec approval.
- Indexation: we agree to the 12% trigger / 10% capped corridor and the 30‑day notice. For extreme supply shocks (>30% quarter over quarter) we will pause automated adjustment and enter a 10‑business‑day negotiation window.
- Burst: 10% burst pool for first 12 months at 1.6x committed rate; option to convert bursts into committed capacity at pre‑agreed conversion credits.

Action items:
1) Pioneer: confirm acceptance of the 12% trigger / 10% cap and the 25% blended ceiling so we can finalize the pricing memo.
2) Pioneer: sign and return the PO draft (po_draft_v2.pdf) or provide your standard PO.
3) Redwood: Kimberly to route pricing memo for Director signoff; Lauren to open the DocuSign envelope once approvals are in.

DocuSign (provisional) and HubSpot record attached: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If all good, I will ask Legal to prepare a contract redline with the indexation and emergency relief language and send over a signed DocuSign link.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Dedicated Capacity Sales, Redwood Inference
